about_the_game:
This DLC grants access to 10 songs including Touhou original "Crazy Backup Dancers"

Release is scheduled for November 27th, 2025.

  • Crazy Backup Dancers (Original Touhou Song)

  • Arrangement Contest Winning Track: Instrumental Category

  • Arrangement Contest Winning Track: Vocal Category

  • Arrangement Contest Winning Track: Boss Theme Category

  • A Dream Transcending Space-time

  • Grip & Break down !!

  • Last Occult Fantasy

  • Special Ability to Excite the Audience feat. Taitson

  • CENSORED!!

  • Armageddon

Check out the official page for details on the songs.
